subject.title: Feature Request: cron.defaults.delivery config for default delivery target

question: Should a configured cron delivery default be copied into new jobs at creation time, or inherited dynamically whenever each job runs, and should it override a trusted active-chat origin?
rationale: These choices determine whether config changes can reroute existing scheduled output and whether a global recipient may displace the chat that authorized the job; source inspection cannot establish that security and UX policy.

options.title: Snapshot safe fallback
options.body: Copy the configured default into new jobs only when neither an explicit destination nor a trusted creation origin exists, leaving existing jobs unchanged.

options.title: Always prefer configured default
options.body: Apply the global destination ahead of captured chat context, making fleet routing predictable but potentially surprising users creating reminders from another chat.

options.title: Dynamic runtime inheritance
options.body: Resolve the default on every run so config edits update all jobs, accepting that existing jobs can silently change recipients.

recommendation.title: Snapshot safe fallback
recommendation.body: Copy the configured default into new jobs only when neither an explicit destination nor a trusted creation origin exists, leaving existing jobs unchanged.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest feature-history trail for cron delivery modes and routing points to this contributor.
